deferred: Needs arrows (move active particle) AND targeted clicks (select particle / colorButton / removeButton). PuzzleScript has only arrows + X, so this uses a MODE TOGGLE: an invisible fixed Player catches input; X toggles arrow-mode<->cursor-mode (cursor spawns at cursor_start, returns to arrow mode by clicking the off-board back_button at row 16). Validated against Autumn for select/move/color-toggle/remove via a modal driver (X to enter cursor mode, walk cursor to (x,y), X to click; arrows return to arrow mode via the back button first). The standard cursor harness policy does not drive this -- a `modal` policy is needed. active/inactive particle state is internal (Autumn renders only green/gold), verified indirectly since only the active particle moves.
